'''Feyenn''' was a female [[Human/Legends|Human]] agent in the [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|Sith Empire]]. During the [[Galactic War]] she was stationed at [[Voss-Ka]] on [[Voss]], where she asked an Imperial to talk with a Republic official [[Girr Antoc]].
